sources.quote: As of October 1, 2026 Our previous disclaimer disclosed the use of AI in drafting some of our original assets. As of October 1, 2026, thanks to the support of our early backers, the use of Aseprite and GIMP, and the work of talented freelance artists, all assets have been redrawn, rebuilt, and redesigned from their original versions, allowing us to move away from AI-generated artwork. We will retain this disclaimer in the interest of complete transparency and to acknowledge the development process behind the game.

identity.description: Become an unstoppable demon-killing machine. Tear through hordes, stack absurd upgrades, and create builds that get completely out of hand.
